name: pendulum-scoped-temporal-contexts
instr:
Pendulum cannot capture and safely scope its effective locale, local timezone, week boundaries, and current time. Add immutable temporal contexts that work coherently across construction, conversion, arithmetic, parsing, intervals, formatting, and humanized differences without changing global or unscoped behavior.

Activations must nest and restore the exact previous configuration after normal or exceptional exit. A `ContextToken` may be reset only once in its originating execution context. Invalid reset raises `ContextTokenError`, a `PendulumException`, without changing state. Copied contexts and concurrent tasks must not share later mutations, activation stacks, or tokens.

Each operation must use one effective snapshot. Explicit locale, timezone, parser, formatter, historical-value, and unknown-time choices remain authoritative. Omitted or local timezone requests use the scoped default; explicit `None`, strings, offsets, and tzinfo objects keep their existing semantics. `DateTime.astimezone` uses the scoped local timezone only when its target is omitted, preserving explicit targets, represented instants, fold, and subclasses. Public construction and `DateTime.create` must agree on contextual wall fields, timezone, fold, and transition errors. Named and fixed zones keep their distinct transition behavior without leaking ambient state.
